notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl with browser UA) worked fully - Shopify storefront, robots.txt allows general crawling (only admin/cart/checkout disallowed, no Claude-specific block). No Playwright/Chrome escalation needed. TREE: built from union of homepage mega-menu (7 top nav groups: Furniture, Outdoor, Rugs, Lighting, Pillows & Decor, Mirrors & Art, Brands - extracted via NavigationTier2-N block parsing) plus the category/collections XML sitemap (~725 collection URLs) plus each relevant collection page's own on-page structure. Site is a large multi-brand marketplace (Safavieh + ~80 partner furniture/lighting/decor brands) built on Shopify; the collections sitemap contains hundreds of legacy/orphan/SKU-level micro-collections (brand names, product codes, size filters) not reachable via current navigation. Cross-checked several sitemap-only handles against nav-linked ones and found exact-duplicate product counts (e.g. rug-pads=7 vs sitemap-only rug-padding=7; outdoor-pillows=529 vs outdoor-pillows-1=529; both literally duplicate Shopify auto-suffixed handles from a title collision) confirming these are redundant/legacy duplicates, not distinct categories - excluded per duplicate-prevention rule, keeping only the currently nav-linked canonical handle. Rug size-filter collections (2x3, 3x5, 4x6, 5x8, 6x9, 8x10, 9x12, 10x14) and the 'Rug Bestsellers'/'Categories' links (both alias back to the parent /collections/rugs) were excluded as facet filters / parent duplicates, not genuine distinct sub-categories. 'New Rug Arrivals' and 'New Decor Arrivals' excluded as promotional new-arrivals pages. QTY: rendered 'utility-bar__item' header text on each collection page ('N products'), confirmed against each page's distinct og:title (not a shared/default title) to verify the slug resolved to the correct node rather than silently serving a parent/site-wide total. EXCLUDED: entire Furniture nav (Living Room, Dining Room, Bedroom incl. Beds/Dressers/Nightstands/Armoires-Wardrobes/Headboards, Office, Bookcases & Etageres, Buffets & Sideboards, Display Cabinets, Media Cabinets, Bar Cabinets) - all explicitly categorized as Furniture by the site's own hierarchy, none reclassified to Storage per storage.md Sec21/27 (site places them under Furniture, not Storage/Organization). Poufs excluded - listed under Furniture nav alongside Stools & Ottomans/Sleepers, i.e. seating furniture. Office Accessories collection inspected and found to be entirely table/desk lamps (Lighting), not storage. Entire Lighting nav excluded (Lighting.xlsx not in scope). Entire Mirrors & Art nav (Mirrors, Wall Decor, Wall Sculptures, Wall Clocks, Candles, Vases, Bowls, Trays, Bottles, Jars, Faux Florals, Sculptures & Objects, Fireplace Accessories, Wreaths & Table Accents, Christmas Trees) excluded as Decorative Home Accessories / Wall Decor, out of scope. No Storage category, section, or product type (boxes, baskets, organizers, bins, closet/wardrobe/shoe/laundry storage, shelving, racks) found anywhere in nav, sitemap keyword sweep, or sub-nav checks - storage_rows is empty; the one storage-shaped sitemap hit 'picnic-baskets' was not textile or genuine home-storage (a carry/utility basket, not organization furniture) and was excluded as neither category. Textile scope reflects the company's core identity as a rug manufacturer/retailer (13 rug sub-types under the Rugs department) plus a small pillows/throws/stockings tail; no bedding, curtains, towels, tablecloths, or kitchen textiles exist on this site.
